description: Wright Strategy fleet preset for Bun, npm, uv/PEP 621, GitHub Actions, and Dockerfile dependencies.

Mend Renovate Cloud Community schedules and serializes repository scans with one organization-wide worker; grouping plus prHourlyLimit bound the resulting update waves without delaying them to a weekly window.

This preset deliberately adds no concurrency cap: grouping and the self-clearing prHourlyLimit bound each wave, while a cap that only a human merge can clear starves the repositories that most need updates.

packageRules.description: Enforce the organization policy that GitHub Actions use immutable full-SHA pins; Renovate's native github-actions manager updates the digest and its trailing version comment together.

Preserve the organization ref-pin policy for reusable workflows from .github and bridge: these moving refs propagate shared standards automatically, so they are exempt from the global GitHub Actions hash-pin rule.

Disable dependency lookups for the .github and bridge namespaces protected by the organization ref-pin policy: these are deliberate moving refs that propagate shared standards automatically, not dependencies awaiting a Renovate bump.
Leave Bun lockfile refreshes to the fleet's existing lockfile-refresh workflow while Renovate maintains uv and npm lockfiles.

Group and platform-automerge every non-major update after a one-day minimum release age; the whole non-major class intentionally remains one routine wave instead of per-class groups to limit fleet PR volume against Mend Community's single organization-wide worker, while majors remain separately reviewable.
Group major updates into a separately reviewable class so breaking changes do not ride with the routine dependency wave.
